messages:
elaine: Quick post-AH follow-up — thanks for the turnout. Sharing the slide deck + a few clarifications and owners so we don't leave things floating. Slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/slides Recording: https://redwood.ai/recordings/allhands-2026-03-20.mp4 Roadmap note: 'Realtime pilot' means a small public pilot focused on short, interactive completions (chat/assist use cases). Target rollout: pilot starts May 1. Key targets and ask list below.

elaine: Action items (high priority):
- @miguel -> final capacity + Dedicated playbook (incl. pre-provisioning checklist) by 2026-04-10
- @jia -> create latency + quality eval prompt set and baseline run by 2026-04-15
- @ash -> surface Dedicated pricing & rollout controls in Console (Admin > Rollouts) by EOW (2026-03-27)
- Product ops / @ops-bot -> create canary runbook for 10% traffic shift (owner: miguel)
Please drop blockers here or DM me.

sam: Quick q — what is the SLA/target for the realtime pilot? p95 < 100ms was mentioned in chat, but slides say 'low-latency'.

elaine: Good callout. Pilot target is: p95 < 150ms for typical short interactions (median tokens ~ 40). We'll publish a latency profile in the pilot doc — it's intentionally looser than a GA SLA while we validate edge cases (cold starts, KV cache warmup).

miguel: I’ll pick up the capacity doc. Note on pricing: reserved pool discounts are being updated (draft): 6-month commit -> 22% off, annual -> 30% off. I’ll PR the pricing page and link to the Console pricing modal. Also will own the canary checklist. @ash can you confirm ops integration?

ash: Confirmed — I’ll add a new section in Console: Admin > Rollouts with an editable canary percentage and a 'pause on error' toggle. Draft link (internal): https://redwood.ai/console/admin/rollouts (draft). I’ll post a brief runbook in #eng-oncall once ready.

jia: For evals — should we include both latency regressions and quality regressions? If yes, I’ll need labeling owners for initial runs; can reuse the conversational prompt sets but need watchers on false positives.

elaine: Yes, include both latency and quality. For labeling owners, @sam volunteered in the AH Q&A.

sam: Happy to help for initial 2 weeks. @jia ping me 2026-04-01 and I’ll triage labels and edge cases.

allhands-bot: Recording uploaded -> https://redwood.ai/recordings/allhands-2026-03-20.mp4 (:white_check_mark:)

miguel: Small pre-sales ask: can we get a short customer-facing blurb describing the Dedicated latency behavior and pilot expectations? I’ll draft but want leadership sign-off. Target draft 2026-04-05.

elaine: Assign that to you — please include the canary behavior (10% traffic to new runtime), pilot targets, and recommended messaging for customers (expectations + opt-in instructions). I’ll review.

ash: Follow-ups from infra: we need the final canary config (percent, metrics, abort thresholds). I’ll wait for miguel’s checklist then implement the Console UI.

ops-bot: Note: create ticket INF-4123 for canary infra changes (owner: ash)

elaine: Thanks everyone — this keeps momentum. If no blockers by EOD Friday I'll spin up the pilot workspace and invite the initial customers. :party_parrot:

sam: Thanks — will sync with @sales on customer invites and pre-sales messaging.

jia: Will post the initial eval PR next week and tag owners.

miguel: Drafting capacity doc now, will tag eng-releases and product.

ash: Updating Console draft, will ping infra.

elaine: Closing note: if you raised a Q during AH and didn’t get an answer, paste it here and I’ll route it to the right person. Appreciate the quick follow-ups.
